text:
alex: Hey team — pushed fixes for the allocator NPE and the routing edge-case, and I addressed @maya's comments. Short summary:
- allocator: add nil guard when shard is missing, moved allocatePath() checks earlier, added unit + integration test.
- routing: fallback to small-batch path for long sequences to avoid huge memory spikes.
- config: bumped default request_timeout from 1s -> 3s (comment added regarding SLO tradeoffs).
CI: unit+lint green locally; canary integration is flaky (see log below). Need 2 approvers to merge before tomorrow's canary window. PTAL when you have a sec :pray:

maya: skimmed the diff — looks good overall. left one tiny nit in the comment about batching semantics. :thumbsup:

cheng: I'll pull and run the integration on my rig. quick Q: the timeout change — did you run any latency numbers at realistic qps?

alex: @cheng good call — I ran a quick local load at ~200 qps: median +40ms, 95th ~+120ms, P99 roughly unchanged. Added the mini-benchmark outputs to the PR description.

ryan: can take a look in ~15. can you paste the failing test log you saw in canary?

alex: pasted log below:
```
--- FAIL: TestRoutingFallback (0.12s)
    routing_test.go:123: expected fallback path but hit panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
    stack: runtime.go:199 +0x...
    internal/routing/router.go:87 allocatePath()
```
I added a guard that addresses the nil case and added a reproducible unit test.

ci-bot: unit tests: passed ✅, integration tests: flaky (1/3) — rerun requested by @alex

ryan: reading now — left 2 tiny nits (variable name + a comment phrasing). functionally looks fine. I'll approve once CI is green.

maya: +1 from me after CI passes and the inline nit is addressed.

alex: done — fixed naming + comment, re-requested CI run, and added a short runbook note in the PR about the timeout change and how to revert if latency sufferers are observed. tagging @eng-oncall in case canary still flakes.

eng-oncall: noted — will keep an eye on canary during tomorrow's rollout window (09:00-11:00 PST). ping if you want me to abort/delay.

alex: awesome, thanks. PTAL again when free — goal is to merge at ~08:50 PST if all checks are green and we have 2 approvals.

ryan: CI just turned green on my side, approving now.

alex: merging shortly once approvals show up. appreciate the quick eyes, everyone :)
